# WebPalm

> WebPalm is a premier web application and custom software development agency headquartered in Dublin, Ireland. We design and engineer scalable web applications, business automation platforms, e-commerce solutions, and digital growth strategies for Irish SMEs and global enterprises.

## Primary Entity Information
- **Organization**: WebPalm

- **Geographic Focus**: Dublin, Cork, Galway, Limerick, wider Ireland, UK, and European Union.

## Core Services
- [Web Development](https://webpalm.ie/web-development): Custom web applications, enterprise software architectures, API development, and responsive website builds using React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and Laravel.
- [Graphic Designing & Video Editing](https://webpalm.ie/graphic-designing): Comprehensive UI/UX interface design, branding systems, social media visual assets, motion graphics, and video production.
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://webpalm.ie/search-engine-optimization): Technical SEO audits, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), keyword strategy, link building, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- [Services Hub](https://webpalm.ie/services): Overview of all digital engineering, cloud migration, and consulting capabilities.
